text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby will soon be upon
us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, the racers have been gathered
for a press
conference about the
challenge before them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahahahah! What am I expectin' from the
Derby?
Do ya even have to ask?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Victory! Triumph! Conquest! What else
could
there be?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Who's the world's strongest racer?! The
Derby is
where that question will be
answered!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Easy now, easy. Keep going on like that
and you'll
tire yourself out before the
race even starts.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Me, on the other hand, I'll be taking it
slow like
always.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
If you wanna know more, you'll just have
to check
out the main event.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
M-my m-motivation?! My motivation is,
um... um!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I-I want my moms and everyone back
home to,
um, see me become number
one in Japan, so...
Umm...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I'll give it my all!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса... Сэйун Скай... Special
Week...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This year's Japanese Derby is stacked
with a
fearsome lineup of
racers—Umamusume who were
turning
heads before they even debuted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With precious little time remaining until
the big
event, the atmosphere among
the racers is
electric, and yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My name is Грасс Вандер. It's a pleasure
to make
your acquaintance.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh, she's here—the Beast's Successor!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! May I ask a question,
please?!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: Go right ahead.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
After your impressive achievements in
your junior
year, there are a lot of hopes
riding on you. Are
you feeling any of
that pressure now?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Well, I would be lying to say I haven't
noticed the
pressure at all. However...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I will nonetheless face this challenge
with a clear
mind and steady
preparations. After all, luck
favors the
brave.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And they do say the luckiest
Umamusume wins
the Japanese Derby,
yes?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Wow, talk about having a cool head!
Next
question...
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Trainer. I finished
the
interview without a hitch.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As I still have plenty of energy
left, I'd like
to get right into some trai—
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
GRAAAAASS! Stop, stop! Stop it right
there!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The Phantom Bird appears outta the
void!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oh... Is something the matter?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Nothin' much! Just droppin' by to remind
ya: This!
Is! War!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Over the top as usual, I see.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Didn't we both already voice our
ambitions in the
press conference?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I heard you talkin', and it was a bunch of

goodie-two-shoes baloney!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I know you've got more fire hidden
under the prim
little Nadeshiko act.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: So that's why I'm here to talk to the real you, Grass!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
To tell you how super, mega, ultra
psyched I am
to face you, frente a
frente, in an all-out clash!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The race to decide who is la primera!
Who is at
the top of the world! Here we
goooo!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: My, my.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер stands there silently for a
moment
before finally saying with a
gentle smile...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Consider it a match.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That little run-in with El cost us time.
Shall we
make up for it, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Well, yes...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
After all, each Classic race is a
once-in-a-lifetime
opportunity.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
El, Sei, Spe... They're going to do
everything in
their power to emerge
victorious in this race.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: But I will not allow them to pass me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
For a far greater shadow looms... further
down
the path I tread.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The seconds are ticking down to the day
of the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
